Kaavakuva samasta mittauksesta kahdella: Schematic of the same measurement in two ways, time axis to scale. At the top is random error: ten results scatter on both sides of the true value 2.40 s, and the mean 2.41 s is close to the true value. At the bottom is systematic error: ten results are in a tight group, but the group is entirely to the right of the true value and the mean 2.59 s is about 0.19 s too large.
Kaavakuva, ei lukuarvoja: kuusi mittaust: Schematic, no numerical values: six measurement results on a time axis. The largest result t_max and the smallest result t_min bound the range, whose length is t_max − t_min. The mean is marked with a vertical line. Half of the range Δt is an estimate of the random error, and the result is given as the mean plus or minus Δt.
Kaavakuva, ei mittakaavassa: keittiövaak: Schematic, not to scale: a kitchen scale shown twice. On the left the pan is empty, but the scale shows 1.2 g, so the zero is wrong. On the right the pan has an iron object and the scale shows 48.7 g. The mass of the object is obtained by subtracting the zero reading from the reading: 48.7 g minus 1.2 g is 47.5 g.
Mittaustulokset (t, aika) mittakaavassa:: Measurement results (t, time) to scale: six results between 3.07 s and 3.31 s, mean 3.18 s and the result 3.18 s ± 0.12 s on a green bar.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: heilurin kymmenen: Graph to scale: the time t of ten swings of a pendulum in five repeats, shown as dots on a time axis. The axis runs from 12.0 seconds to 13.0 seconds, with vertical lines and small tick marks at every 0.1 seconds and numbers at every 0.2 seconds. The dots are at 12.2 s, 12.4 s, 12.6 s, 12.7 s and 12.9 s.
